mentions.name: Virtually Attend FOSDEM
mentions.description: A listings site for virtually attending FOSDEM that lets users browse sessions in their own time zone, since the official FOSDEM site only lists sessions in local Brussels time.
mentions.problem: The official FOSDEM site only lists sessions in the local Brussels time zone.
mentions.source_excerpt: A listings site for virtually attending FOSDEM. The live streaming is great but the official site only lists sessions in the local Brussels time zone. You can choose your time zone here: https://virtuallyattend.teacaketech.scot/fosdem/2026/
